summary: The study investigates the atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) growth of ZnSe on GaAs(0 0 1) using RHEED and TRAXS. The ALE process alternates Zn and Se exposures, with a growth rate of approximately 0.5 BL per cycle. The surface reconstruction alternates between Se-stabilized (2]1) and Zn-stabilized c(2]2) reconstructions, and the growth mode transitions between island and layer-by-layer depending on the surface treatment.
evidence: The experiments were performed at 250 3C by alternately supplying Zn and Se for 150 s each, with a short interval of growth interruption (30 s) in between. The growth rate of ZnSe has been estimated to be about 0.5 BL per ALE cycle.
